followUpEmail.subject: Meeting Follow-up: Orion Project Check-in
followUpEmail.body:
Hi Orion team,

Thanks for a productive check-in today. Here is a summary of our confirmed commitments, pending requests, and action items:

Confirmed Commitments:
- Approved Launch Date: October 20
- Scope: Account onboarding, migration of existing customer profiles, and read-only reporting dashboard (custom reporting and billing automation remain out of scope).
- Rollout: Staged rollout starting with the pilot customer group, ensuring existing customer access remains available.

Pending Requests:
- Client requested to move the launch date to October 18. This remains an open request awaiting sponsor sign-off and is not currently approved.

Action Items & Deadlines:
- Priya Nair: Complete onboarding migration by October 15.
- Daniel Kim: Deliver quality assurance test summary (including unresolved pilot defects) by October 16.
- [Not stated]: Update the rollback plan before launch.
- [Not stated]: Review pilot feedback.

Please let us know if any details need adjustment.

Best regards,
Meeting Follow-up Assistant
